name: Jüdisches Museum Wien
notes: Uses the site's internal ausstellung_liste JSON app (POST cmd=filterResults) for aktuell+vorschau exhibitions, one record per exhibition with a far end (or null end + extra.permanent for the two Dauerausstellungen and the always-on online exhibition). Site publishes exhibitions well over a year ahead (through 2028). price_min is the general adult day ticket (EUR 15) scraped from the Preise page, applied to all physical-venue exhibitions; the online exhibition gets null price (never stated as free).
